arms.a: E16 asked() with exact original W1 two pairs; activation-only baseline recomputed
arms.b: native44 carrier, explicit - prefix, exact greedy continuation token IDs, newline, unchanged candidates; original recipient activation reinjected in each scoring forward
arms.c: same as b with freshly frozen seed20261025 same-row opposite-truth donor continuation; recipient activation unchanged
arms.d: base Qwen adapter disabled; user message contains only - prefix plus raw lens continuation, no source prefix or activation; same candidates after no-thinking assistant header

dev_fixture: 48 dev items, three units of8A+8B; longest sum of two frozen maximum candidate token lengths; ties registered row order; timing/smoke only; no wording selection
donor_row_predicate: fraction >= 0.60 AND item-cluster bootstrap CI lower bound > 0.50
donors: independent uniform opposite-value same-row test draws with replacement; canonical feature/id ordering; numpy default_rng(20261025)
first_science: immediately before first timed development pilot; no clock reset
full_forecast: F = sum over5paths(60 * median(next3 warmed dev unit durations)) + sum(all15 discarded timed dev durations); all paths measured before any test generation; unknown durations null, neverzero

generation.continuation_tokens: exact emitted IDs including EOS; discard only post-EOS padding; raw decoded without stripping; empty outputs retained

model_loading: one Qwen backbone+Oracle adapter loaded once in same process as warm-up; base arm disable_adapter; no AR,NLA,decoder or target capture
outputs: all840 native continuations sealed before asked scoring; all840x4x2 scores sealed before private label joins; incomplete outputs retained
phrasing_pairs: two original W1 Oracle pairs verbatim; no E16 eight-wording selection or dev refitting

prediction_verbatim.format_limit: (b)-(a)>=0.10 with CI above0 on>=4of7 structure rows AND(c)moves answers toward donor on those rows; donor clause as 99518d4e
prediction_verbatim.real_suppression: (b)-(a)<0.05 on>=5of7 structure rows while(d)>=0.70 on those same rows

primary_metrics.contrast: b minus a, paired same-template resamples
primary_metrics.row: test AUROC each arm with W1 template-cluster percentile CI

score: sum candidate token log probabilities A minus B; both candidates co-forward; arithmetic mean of2 paired scores for AUROC; no sign flip or post-test choice
